links.outcome: LLM accuracy on radiology board-style questions under cognitively biased prompt variations
links.effect: Biased prompts reduced accuracy, especially on image-based tasks; prompt-level mitigations were effective but only partially restored accuracy (no numbers in available text).
links.quote: Large language model accuracy for radiology board–style questions was reduced by prompts that mimicked cognitive biases, especially on image-based tasks, and prompt-level mitigations, although effective, only partially restored accuracy.

screen.reason: The study tests LLM and multimodal model performance on radiology board-style questions when subjected to cognitively biased prompts and evaluates prompt-level mitigations/guardrails designed to counter these biases.
